newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bogota stocks close lower ahead of earnings news.
newsitem.headline: Bogota stocks close lower ahead of earnings news.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed down in active trading dominiated by blue chips.
Bogota's IBB price index closed down 0.35 percent at 1,197.03 on turnover of about 4.7 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED general price index dipped 0.63 percent to 18,223.88.

Dealers said apprehension among investors about second-quarter earnings due out next week contributed to the decline. Also, persistent speculation about a possible devaluation of Brazil's currency has made foreign funds wary of other emerging markets, including Colombia.
Brewer Bavaria was one of the day's biggest decliners, finishing down 1.09 percent at 8,100 pesos in Bogota, and down 2.12 percent at 8,001 pesos in Medellin.
Banco de Bogota closed down 0.72 percent to 6,850 in Bogota and down 0.86 percent to 6,850 in Medellin.
Cement maker Compania de Cemento Argos fell 0.58 percent to 8,848 in Bogota and ended down 0.58 percent to 8,850 in Medellin.
